import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as ticker
import numpy as np
import json
import os

outdir = '/root/autodl-tmp/trace-verdict-study-checkpoints/budget_curve_corrected'

# === Data (Table 12, whole-input tail truncation) ===
budgets = [256, 384, 512, 1024, 2048]

data = {
    'Qwen2.5-Coder-7B': {
        'budgets': [256, 384, 512, 1024, 2048],
        'acc':     [77.48, 79.80, 93.60, 96.47, 97.30],
        'color': '#2166ac', 'marker': 'o',
    },
    'DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B': {
        'budgets': [256, 384, 512, 1024, 2048],
        'acc':     [76.39, 80.70, 93.90, 96.47, 94.96],
        'color': '#d6604d', 'marker': 's',
    },
    'Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B': {
        'budgets': [256, 384, 512, 1024, 2048],
        'acc':     [72.60, 73.61, 95.60, 96.60, 97.90],
        'color': '#4daf4a', 'marker': '^',
    },
    'CodeLlama-13B': {
        'budgets': [256, 384, 512, 1024],
        'acc':     [77.90, 82.69, 98.24, 98.24],
        'color': '#ff7f00', 'marker': 'D',
    },
}

# Reference lines
no_trace_baseline = 75.13
majority_baseline = 71.51

# Qwen-7B full (no truncation) point
full_no_trunc = {'budget': 2048, 'acc': 81.76}  # plotted at x=2048 but hollow

# CodeLlama-13B catastrophic failure
codellama_fail = {'budget': 2048, 'acc': 28.49}

# === Plot ===
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4.5))

for name, d in data.items():
    ax.plot(d['budgets'], d['acc'], color=d['color'], marker=d['marker'],
            markersize=7, linewidth=2, label=name, zorder=3)

# Qwen-7B "full (no trunc)" hollow marker
ax.plot(2300, full_no_trunc['acc'], marker='o', markersize=8,
        markerfacecolor='white', markeredgecolor='#2166ac', markeredgewidth=2,
        zorder=4, linestyle='none')
ax.annotate('full input\n(no trunc.)', xy=(2300, full_no_trunc['acc']),
            xytext=(2500, 85), fontsize=8, color='#2166ac',
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#2166ac', lw=1.2),
            ha='left', va='center')

# CodeLlama-13B catastrophic failure
ax.plot(2048, codellama_fail['acc'], marker='X', markersize=10,
        color='#e31a1c', zorder=5, linestyle='none')
ax.annotate('catastrophic\nfailure', xy=(2048, codellama_fail['acc']),
            xytext=(1300, 35), fontsize=8, color='#e31a1c', fontweight='bold',
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#e31a1c', lw=1.2),
            ha='center', va='center')

# Reference lines
ax.axhline(no_trace_baseline, color='gray', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.2, zorder=1)
ax.text(245, no_trace_baseline + 0.8, 'no-trace baseline (75.13%)',
        fontsize=8, color='gray', va='bottom')

ax.axhline(majority_baseline, color='#999999', linestyle=':', linewidth=1.2, zorder=1)
ax.text(245, majority_baseline - 2.2, 'majority baseline (71.51%)',
        fontsize=8, color='#999999', va='top')

# Phase transition shading
ax.axvspan(384, 512, alpha=0.10, color='#feb24c', zorder=0)
ax.annotate('', xy=(500, 69), xytext=(395, 69),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#b35900', lw=1.5))
ax.text(443, 66.5, 'phase\ntransition', fontsize=8, color='#b35900',
        ha='center', va='top', fontstyle='italic')

# Axes
ax.set_xscale('log', base=2)
ax.set_xticks(budgets)
ax.get_xaxis().set_major_formatter(ticker.ScalarFormatter())
ax.set_xlim(220, 3200)
ax.set_ylim(25, 102)
ax.set_xlabel('Token Budget (tail truncation length)', fontsize=11)
ax.set_ylabel('Accuracy (%)', fontsize=11)
ax.tick_params(labelsize=10)

# Legend
ax.legend(fontsize=9, loc='lower right', framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='#cccccc')

# Style
ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.2, linewidth=0.5)

plt.tight_layout()

# === Save ===
pdf_path = os.path.join(outdir, 'budget_curve_table12.pdf')
png_path = os.path.join(outdir, 'budget_curve_table12.png')
json_path = os.path.join(outdir, 'budget_curve_table12.json')

fig.savefig(pdf_path, bbox_inches='tight')
fig.savefig(png_path, dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
print(f'Saved: {pdf_path}')
print(f'Saved: {png_path}')

# JSON with raw data
json_data = {
    'description': 'Budget curve - Table 12 (whole-input tail truncation)',
    'baselines': {'no_trace': no_trace_baseline, 'majority': majority_baseline},
    'qwen7b_full_no_trunc': full_no_trunc,
    'codellama13b_catastrophic': codellama_fail,
    'models': {}
}
for name, d in data.items():
    json_data['models'][name] = {
        'budgets': d['budgets'],
        'accuracy_pct': d['acc']
    }
with open(json_path, 'w') as f:
    json.dump(json_data, f, indent=2)
print(f'Saved: {json_path}')
print('Done.')
